name: atlas
line: the claims, findings and judgment calls in the work, with their evidence, in named clusters
writer: a subagent of main, guided by SKILL.md: it reads with lean rows and lean q and writes the atlas as JSON; main saves it with `lean verb atlas save`, so the object is drawn under main's reply
adds: a later message adds its claims with one quiet $.model.complete call (run.mjs), saved as the atlas's next version

forms.terminal: a cluster list: each cluster's name, a dot per claim colored by kind, its count and its lead claim
forms.detail: every claim under its cluster, each one a part with its evidence
forms.browser: a force graph of the claims (shell/browser/atlas/)

keys.a: with no atlas yet: ask Claude to build it (offered with its time and cost, never started on its own); with one: add this message's claims, or show it
